data.body: Completion evidence for the external `[non-codebase]` acceptance criterion: Gerrit change 3004 revision `4641389f19a32092a17985c4b9b08f5fe9b3aab5` received `Verified +1` from the CI bot, and submit returned MERGED. The merged commit on `origin/main` is `c0b1ad2e8e929f839968b194f59109011a8d3669` (`c0b1ad2e8e9`), carrying `rebar-ticket: 0fb0-5c46-66ae-405d`. The local full `make verify` equivalent remains unsuitable on this macOS arm64 host because `pypandoc-binary==1.17`'s arm64 wheel ships an x86_64 `pandoc`, which fails 17 unrelated pandoc tests with `Bad CPU type in executable`; CI's Linux gating cell is the relevant full-suite evidence. Targeted checks were run from an extracted `c0b1ad2e8e9` tree because the shared checkout differed from the merged revision in the touched files. Exact targeted test summaries: `48 passed in 50.13s` for `env PATH="$repo/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py -q`; `============================== 48 passed in 3.20s ==============================` for the exact criterion command `env PATH="$repo/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py`. `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` exited 0 with empty stdout and stderr against the extracted merged tree.
